scope: Read-only source-driven parity inventory; not an assertion that iOS behavior or Android parity has passed physical acceptance.
note_on_requested_743_files: This checkout currently contains 575 repository Swift files, not 743. Audit uses actual present source, executable hub/toolbox destinations and representative implementation files; does not claim line-by-line review of every file.
platform_policy: Equivalent Android functions replace Apple-only frameworks; no invented unsupported on-device capabilities. Optional third-party/AI/billing integration remains optional, free manual/local paths retained.

features.feature: Five hub shell, drawer, global search, adaptive layout and theme
acceptance_cases: Home/Cook/Inventory/Recipes/Grocery route identically by purpose.
Drawer actions and global search reach every implemented destination.
Phone portrait, Deck landscape, tablet split screen and 200% font have no clipped or inaccessible controls.
Back restores owning hub and process recreation preserves selected flow.
features.remaining_gap: Current Compose shell resembles iOS but drawer/action breadth, motion, global cross-domain search and visual parity need source/screenshot comparison.

acceptance_cases: Add/edit quantities, package size, unit, fill and all four storage zones; restart retains values.
Unknown product fields survive Android edits and mixed-version household sync.
No nonfinite quantities or invalid calendar dates persist.
features.remaining_gap: Missing subzones/custom categories, X-of-Y usage, product photo editing, purchase metadata, source confidence and par levels.

features.feature: Grocery planning, checked lists, grouping, deduplication and purchase transfer
acceptance_cases: Exact names/package sizes deduplicate without losing IDs.
Checked rows, recipe groups and reassignment survive restart.
Review purchased groceries into inventory without duplicate consumption or purchase events.
features.remaining_gap: Missing store assignment/layout, usuals/templates, purchase dedup review, product/cost enrichment and inventory purchase handoff.

features.feature: Manual recipe creation/editing, details, favorites, portions, source credit
acceptance_cases: Create/edit complete recipe, ingredients, directions, servings and source credit; save/restart.
Imported license/author/image attribution survive modifications/export.
Ingredient fractions scale without fabricating quantities or allergen safety.
features.remaining_gap: Missing images, rich notes, dish-role classification, nutrition, substitution selection, collection-intent review and cooking history.

features.feature: Recipe vault, catalogs, browse/discovery, pantry matching and collections
acceptance_cases: Browse licensed bundled/remote recipes with filters, search and real images.
Pantry matching respects ingredients, amounts, equipment, diets and substitutions; missing data remains unknown.
Save/favorite/catalog source state works offline after content caching.
features.remaining_gap: Only local saved recipe search/exact pantry matching currently exists; catalog/discovery feeds, cuisines, quality, source health and complete match engine absent.

features.feature: Reviewed recipe imports: URL, share, text, JSON, CSV, Cooklang and catalogs
acceptance_cases: Import bounded public JSON-LD website; reject local/private networks and unsafe redirects.
Android share imports preview before persistent commit.
CSV/JSON/Cooklang, source metadata and instruction boundaries match published formats.
Duplicate import presents deterministic choices and preserves private originals.
features.remaining_gap: No social/video extraction, catalog migration review, RecipeNLG/Kaggle large streaming imports, original portable-source storage/approval or full connection federation.

features.feature: Receipt and barcode scanning, review, OCR and learning
acceptance_cases: Bundled OCR/barcode works offline without Google Play services.
Rotate/large image bounds work; cancellation cannot save unreviewed items.
Receipt review retains quantities, prices/store/date and source confidence.
One approved receipt commit persists atomically and schedules one sync.
features.remaining_gap: Current OCR text requires manual one-name-per-line cleanup; AI receipt normalization, product enrichment, corrections/learning, review metadata and shelf recognition missing.

features.feature: Cook Now sessions, steps, persistent progress, timers and inventory consumption
acceptance_cases: Resume step/serving/timer state after process death/reboot.
Finishing records cooked history and explicit ingredient deductions exactly once.
Cancel cooking discards only session state and preserves planned meal.
Multiple step timers survive background with clear permission fallback.
features.remaining_gap: Android has one persistent timer and basic cooking steps/explicit inventory consumption; durable full sessions, consumption review, cook history, multi timers and prep workspace absent.

features.feature: Weekly meal plan, dated planning, cook-ahead and calendar exchange
acceptance_cases: Relative week and absolute dated meals remain separate and correct across midnight/timezones.
Plan/import/export preserves servings/ingredients and emits RFC5545 without calendar access.
Cook-ahead retains planned date while managing cooling/storage/reheat phases.
features.remaining_gap: Basic day/date meals only; no calendar ICS, recurring rules/templates, scheduledMeals, cook-ahead or readiness/prep orchestration.

features.feature: Household membership and durable authenticated core sync
acceptance_cases: iOS creates household; Android joins with device credential and both converge CRUD/quantity/deletions.
Lost response/restart retries same operation keys exactly once; edits made in flight retained.
Denied permission or tombstone shows recoverable conflict; no data is silently dropped.
Network/401/429/backoff conditions retain journal and avoid polling storms.
features.remaining_gap: Core four collections only; real cross-platform device acceptance not completed; advanced collections/conflict UI and full permission overrides absent.

features.feature: Household roles, invites, presence, activity, shared cook and delivery
acceptance_cases: Owner manages roles/permissions and revokes membership; removed clients cannot pull/push.
Invitation expires/one-time usage honored; realtime foreground updates merge once.
Shared active cook coarse progress, presence/activity and optional signed delivery are bounded/private.
features.remaining_gap: Android facade currently exposes only create/join/pull/push/leave, no owner management/invite generation/presence/activity/realtime/delivery/shared-cook UI.

features.feature: Readable/encrypted backup, migration, section preview and recovery
acceptance_cases: Import/export round trip every released model/unknown section, dates and IDs across iOS/Android.
Preview counts/overlaps, cancel/no-op, replace selected collisions; failures leave original disk untouched.
Encrypted .stocked recovery key authenticates manifest and payload and rejects tamper.
features.remaining_gap: Readable foundation only; encrypted .stocked currently refused, section selection/media/recovery/snapshot migration and complete synthesized iOS new-record compatibility require fixtures.

features.feature: Nutrition, meal logging, allergens/diets, health integration
acceptance_cases: Allergen unknowns are visible; no ingredient is declared safe from name-only inference.
Macros/servings/meal log preserve provenance and unknowns.
Health integration separately asks permissions; offline nutrition remains usable.
features.remaining_gap: No Android dietary profiles/nutrition/meal log/Health Connect implementation.
features.platform_equivalent: Health Connect optional equivalent for HealthKit; preserve manual mode without provider.

features.feature: Kitchen assistant, recipe generation, intent updates and on-device AI
acceptance_cases: AI proposal preview must require review before mutation; cancel/retry/duplicate cannot overwrite.
Quota/offline/provider failures retain manual workflows and never silently incur paid fallback.
No service/admin/provider secret in APK or exports.
features.remaining_gap: No authenticated Android AI bootstrap/provider settings/guarded proposal engines.
features.platform_equivalent: Apple Foundation Models replaced by optional compatible local model or existing bounded Worker; no mandatory purchase.

features.feature: Grocy/calendar, Cooklang federation and community price connections
acceptance_cases: Connect own service using private local credentials; explicit reviewed import only.
Optional CalDAV edits reviewed and reversible; no credentials in household/export.
Community prices preserve ODbL/source attribution and do not send private receipt proof.
features.remaining_gap: Connection clients, review UI, separate imported ledger, price watches and service discovery missing.

features.feature: Daily brief, health score, expiry/reorder, trends and recommendations
acceptance_cases: Displayed counts/recommendations reflect authoritative current data after edits/restart.
Expiry uses local dates; brief toggles omit disabled household content.
Recommendations show source, staleness and offline fallback.
features.remaining_gap: Home counts/pantry match/expiry cards exist; brief, health score, household context and substantive recommendations absent.

features.feature: Onboarding, cooking profile, account identity, app lock and preferences
acceptance_cases: Guest mode fully usable; optional account linking does not erase kitchen.
Diets/cuisines/equipment/person profiles persist and influence features.
Biometric lock protects app entry and handles recovery; data reset clearly scopes local versus remote.
features.remaining_gap: Only appearance/basic settings; onboarding/profile/account linking/app lock/preferences/reset missing.
features.platform_equivalent: Android Keystore/BiometricPrompt; browser or Credential Manager identity when configured.

features.feature: Daily brief and food-expiry notifications, deep links and actions
acceptance_cases: Notification permissions optional; timer/expiry/brief distinct channels.
Reboot and notification action open correct record without double consumption.
Quiet hours and disabled content remain private.
features.remaining_gap: Cooking timer alert only; daily brief/expiry/reorder schedules, quiet hours and rich actions absent.

features.feature: Home/lock-screen widgets and live cooking progress
acceptance_cases: Widget shows durable latest snapshot after mutation/reboot and never stale erased data.
Live cooking notification reflects deadline/progress while backgrounded.
No custom widget tap exposes private content before lock policy.
features.remaining_gap: No Android widgets or live notification UI.
features.platform_equivalent: Glance AppWidget plus ongoing notification; iOS Live Activity does not port directly.

acceptance_cases: Wear OS grocery checklist/cook timer and phone sync work without duplicating authoritative store.
Unavailable watch does not break phone.
features.remaining_gap: No Wear OS companion.
features.platform_equivalent: Wear OS optional independent module, not Apple Watch binary.

features.feature: Siri/App Intents, Spotlight, speech and voice cook controls
acceptance_cases: Voice/read-aloud controls support pause and cancel without unintended actions.
Android app links/share/search open intended item and require confirmation for mutating commands.
features.remaining_gap: Only share text intent; no assistant shortcuts, indexing, TTS or voice controls.
features.platform_equivalent: Android app shortcuts/App Links, TTS, optional speech recognition.

features.feature: QA tickets, diagnostics, invariant checks and recovery
acceptance_cases: Diagnostic export redacts credentials/private content; report queue durable with retries.
QA scopes app/device and preserves ticket history; production users not exposed to debug controls.
Corrupt local store retains recovery export and refuses overwrite.
features.remaining_gap: Android error banners only; no QA/recovery diagnostic tooling, crash/performance acceptance instrumentation.

features.feature: Android release/signing, reproducible builds, privacy and distribution
acceptance_cases: Signed universal APK installs on x86_64 Deck and arm64 device and upgrades without data loss.
All native libraries satisfy 16KB compatibility; privacy policy/permission rationale/licenses and deletion requirements reviewed.
GitHub source/build reports and backup policy completed; optional Play publication uses own configured account.
features.remaining_gap: Preview signed build exists but no broad physical acceptance/store listing/billing equivalents; Google Play account requirements are not free.
features.platform_equivalent: Free direct signed APK/GitHub releases; Play optional account setup.

overall_status: Substantial partial native preview; full iOS functional/design parity not complete.
verification_gates: Complete source contract fixtures and local unit/lint/signed builds.
Physical x86_64 Waydroid and arm64 phone acceptance including process death/offline/network retry.
Visual/accessibility comparison across hubs, sheets, typography, tablet and Deck.
Every missing/partial group has implemented consumer flow and acceptance evidence before full-parity claim.
inspection_limitations: Bounded source review of executable entry points, models and adapters; presence in iOS source is not proof of deployed/released availability.
UI agent is concurrently adding guided cooking, Tan appearance and favorite toggles; those changes are pending compile/acceptance and are not marked complete by this inventory.
39 tests/signed build/16KB ELF checks were reported by coordinator before this audit; this artifact does not convert them into per-feature physical evidence.

latest_refinement.source_review: Codex plus Claude CLI read-only review; targeted sync follow-up found no material issues after fixes
limitations: Full iOS functional and visual parity remains incomplete.
No live two-device household acceptance in this batch.
Steam Deck unreachable during latest installation attempt.
Unsaved editor drafts are not fully persistent across process death.
Read-only membership permits device-local edits; those edits do not sync.
Oversized household documents fail safely at transport/import bounds.

toolbox_batch.summary: Ported 10 iOS Kitchen Toolbox tools plus allergen warnings and low-fill grocery action as offline Android flows.
toolbox_batch.evidence: ToolboxParityTest (9 tests) and KitchenToolsTest compiled with standalone kotlinc 2.1.0 and passed under JUnit 4.13.2; full Gradle unit/lint/assemble runs in GitHub Actions (no Android SDK in cloud container).
toolbox_batch.not_claimed: No device, visual or accessibility acceptance; statuses moved from missing to partial only.
